The '''Jabiim system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] and the [[Jabiim (star)|cognominal star]].

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Jabiim system was the theater of a [[Operation Silent Roar|battle]] concluded with a Sith victory.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=space|Jabiim Escort}}</ref>
